title: Dispatch start marker (dispatch-start)
description: Appended by every dispatched project-defined agent (except pipeline-coordinator) as its first tool call. Forms half of the dispatch-event contract: a dispatch-start for (req_id, agent) with no subsequent substantive record from the same agent is the deterministic truncation signal, without requiring any runtime-specific signal. Substantive records are the closed enum {build-pass, build-failure, review-feedback, prd-entry, design-block, consultation-response}; consultation-request, design-doc-autofix, and dispatch-start itself are explicitly NOT substantive. The pipeline-coordinator is exempt — its output is a routing recommendation in the response stream, not a substantive .scratch/ record, so 'start without substantive record' would always fire. The contract is prompt-side discipline; there is no runtime enforcement.

author.description: The dispatched agent's name. Closed enum of the seven project-defined agents that write substantive records. pipeline-coordinator is intentionally omitted (exempt from the contract per the description above).

responding_to.description: 1-indexed line numbers in .scratch/handoff.jsonl pointing to the record(s) this dispatch is responding to. Empty array is invalid — every dispatch responds to at least one prior record (a prd-entry for system-design-expert and feature-implementer, a build-pass for reviewers, a review-feedback for the implementer after changes_requested, a consultation-request for the consulted specialist, a design-block with supersedes_record_at for re-triage). For the very first dispatch in a fresh feature context where no prior record exists, set to [0] as a sentinel meaning 'fresh feature, no inbound record.'
